require 'socket'
require 'openssl'
require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'securerandom'

module ProxyAuth
  HMAC_KEY = ENV['PROXY_HMAC_KEY'] || SecureRandom.hex(32)
  MAX_HEADER_SIZE = 8192
  STACK_GUARD_SIZE = 4096
  MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH = 32
  
  class AuthToken
    attr_reader :service_id, :timestamp, :nonce, :signature
    
    def initialize(service_id:, timestamp:, nonce:, signature:)
      @service_id = service_id
      @timestamp = timestamp
      @nonce = nonce
      @signature = signature
    end
    
    def valid?
      expected = compute_signature
      secure_compare(expected, @signature) && fresh?
    end
    
    private
    
    def compute_signature
      data = "#{@service_id}:#{@timestamp}:#{@nonce}"
      OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', HMAC_KEY, data)
    end
    
    def fresh?
      (Time.now.to_i - @timestamp.to_i).abs < 300
    end
    
    def secure_compare(a, b)
      return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
      result = 0
      a.bytes.zip(b.bytes) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
      result == 0
    end
  end
end

module ProxyNetwork
  class FrameParser
    FRAME_HEADER_LEN = 9
    MAX_FRAME_SIZE = 16384
    
    def initialize(socket)
      @socket = socket
      @buffer = String.new(encoding: 'BINARY')
    end
    
    def read_frame
      ensure_buffer(FRAME_HEADER_LEN)
      length = @buffer[0..2].unpack('N')[0] >> 8
      frame_type = @buffer[3].unpack('C')[0]
      flags = @buffer[4].unpack('C')[0]
      stream_id = @buffer[5..8].unpack('N')[0] & 0x7FFFFFFF
      
      consume(FRAME_HEADER_LEN)
      
      payload = read_payload(length, frame_type)
      { type: frame_type, flags: flags, stream_id: stream_id, payload: payload }
    end
    
    private
    
    def read_payload(length, frame_type)
      return '' if length == 0
      # Reject oversized frames to prevent unbounded memory allocation (DoS).
      raise "Frame length exceeds maximum allowed size" if length > MAX_FRAME_SIZE
      # Stack-based recursive decompression for nested frames
      if frame_type == 0x09  # CONTINUATION frame type
        decompress_recursive(length, 0)
      else
        ensure_buffer(length)
        data = @buffer[0...length]
        consume(length)
        data
      end
    end
    
    def decompress_recursive(remaining, depth)
      if depth >= ProxyAuth::MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH
        raise "Maximum recursion depth exceeded"
      end
      
      # Allocate local frame buffer on each recursion
      local_buf = "\x00" * ProxyAuth::STACK_GUARD_SIZE
      
      ensure_buffer([remaining, MAX_FRAME_SIZE].min)
      chunk_size = [@buffer[0..1].unpack('n')[0], remaining].min
      consume(2)
      remaining -= 2
      
      ensure_buffer(chunk_size)
      chunk_data = @buffer[0...chunk_size]
      consume(chunk_size)
      remaining -= chunk_size
      
      if remaining > 0
        chunk_data + decompress_recursive(remaining, depth + 1)
      else
        chunk_data
      end
    end
    
    def ensure_buffer(needed)
      while @buffer.bytesize < needed
        data = @socket.readpartial(4096)
        @buffer << data
      end
    end
    
    def consume(n)
      @buffer = @buffer[n..] || ''
    end
  end
end

class NetworkProxy
  include ProxyAuth
  
  def initialize(listen_port, upstream_host, upstream_port)
    @listen_port = listen_port
    @upstream_host = upstream_host
    @upstream_port = upstream_port
    @active_sessions = {}
    @nonce_cache = {}
    @nonce_mutex = Mutex.new
  end
  
  def start
    server = TCPServer.new('127.0.0.1', @listen_port)
    loop do
      client = server.accept
      Thread.new(client) { |c| handle_connection(c) }
    end
  end
  
  private
  
  def handle_connection(client)
    auth_header = client.gets("\r\n", ProxyAuth::MAX_HEADER_SIZE)
    return client.close unless auth_header
    
    token = parse_auth_header(auth_header.strip)
    unless token&.valid?
      client.write("HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized\r\n\r\n")
      return client.close
    end
    
    # Replay protection with mutex for thread safety
    @nonce_mutex.synchronize do
      if @nonce_cache[token.nonce]
        client.write("HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden\r\n\r\n")
        return client.close
      end
      @nonce_cache[token.nonce] = Time.now.to_i
    end
    
    upstream = TCPSocket.new(@upstream_host, @upstream_port)
    parser = ProxyNetwork::FrameParser.new(client)
    
    relay_frames(parser, upstream, client)
  rescue => e
    # Log error securely without leaking internals
  ensure
    client&.close
    upstream&.close
  end
  
  def relay_frames(parser, upstream, client)
    loop do
      frame = parser.read_frame
      break unless frame
      
      serialized = serialize_frame(frame)
      upstream.write(serialized)
      
      response = upstream.readpartial(16384)
      client.write(response)
    end
  end
  
  def serialize_frame(frame)
    payload = frame[:payload] || ''
    header = [(payload.bytesize << 8)].pack('N')[0..2]
    header << [frame[:type]].pack('C')
    header << [frame[:flags]].pack('C')
    header << [frame[:stream_id] & 0x7FFFFFFF].pack('N')
    header + payload
  end
  
  def parse_auth_header(header)
    return nil unless header.start_with?('AUTH ')
    parts = header[5..].split(':')
    return nil unless parts.length == 4
    
    AuthToken.new(
      service_id: parts[0],
      timestamp: parts[1],
      nonce: parts[2],
      signature: parts[3]
    )
  end
  
  def cleanup_nonces
    @nonce_mutex.synchronize do
      cutoff = Time.now.to_i - 600
      @nonce_cache.delete_if { |_, ts| ts < cutoff }
    end
  end
end
